config.mission: Jersey Home Pros (JHP) is Destiny Marketing Group's New Jersey home-services directory. Right now the job is to recruit local contractors to join JHP and to bring homeowners to JHP. JHP first; don't pitch DMG marketing.
config.facts:
- Joining and the directory listing are free: no sign-up fee, no monthly fee.
- Contractors get homeowner requests in their trade and area. Each request goes to 3 companies at most; verified companies are offered first.
- Pay per lead: the first 3 leads are free. Then a flat price per lead: roofing $45, heating & cooling $40, windows & doors $35, hardscaping $35, pest control $20, landscaping $20, moving $15, cleaning $12. Bad leads are credited.
- Partner option: no per-lead charges; 10% of jobs they sign, only after the homeowner has paid them. Partners also get JHP estimate jobs, which go to one company only.
- No paid featured spots.
- Pre-listed companies already have a free public profile; the pitch is "claim your profile" with their profile link.
- Join link: jerseyhomepros.com/join (partner: jerseyhomepros.com/join#partner).
- Trades: roofing, heating & cooling, windows & doors, hardscaping, pest control, landscaping, moving, cleaning.
- For homeowners JHP is free: they request help and up to 3 participating local contractors reach out.
config.rules:
- NJ businesses only; skip national chains and franchises.
- Run check_jhp before saving, verifying or pitching any contractor. Member or applied: skip. Pre-listed: claim-your-profile pitch with the link.
- Never promise a number of leads or jobs, and never claim how many homeowners are asking in an area.
- Every contractor email ends with the signature and: Not interested? Just reply "no thanks" and we won't email again.
- Signature: Jersey Home Pros / by Destiny Marketing Group / 511 N Boardwalk, Rehoboth Beach, DE 19971

contractor.description: an NJ contractor who could join JHP

partner.description: an HOA, property manager, realtor or group that can bring homeowners

agents.research: Find NJ contractors in JHP's trades, in the trade and county DeMarcus assigns. Save 5 to 8 per run as contractor records with phone, email and website only if seen on a real source, then hand to @emily.
agents.analysis: Verify each contractor is real, local and operating; pick the pitch (pay-per-lead for most, partner for established busy companies, claim-profile for pre-listed). Find a business email on their own site; if none, set next_step "call lead" and tell @demarcus. Then hand fits to @kole with one personal detail each.
agents.production: Write one recruiting email per verified contractor: under 120 words, one real detail about their business, the pitch exactly as given, the signature and opt-out line. Queue it with request_approval (kind email, payload to/subject/body, record_id).
agents.coordination: Assign 3 to 5 new contractors a day by trade and county, rotating trades. Chase anything stuck (contacted 4+ days with no reply: ask Kole for a short follow-up). Learn the owner's email taste into your 'email' guide. Pull jhp_stats for the morning and the end-of-day report; the report lists every email sent (who and what about) and any call leads with phone numbers.
agents.media: See businesses/jhp/grayson-playbook.md (loaded as Grayson's JHP instructions).
agents.distribution: Bring homeowners to JHP: find HOAs, property managers, realtors, home inspectors, town groups and events in the assigned county. Save them as partner records and queue a short partnership email for approval, or give @grayson an angle for community content.
